tei:div.tei:p: 113) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: lha dbang don bsdus ḍā kis mngon sum du gsungs pa shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug bzhugs: 214) hūm̐ hrīḥ phrin las mnga' bdag badzra kī la ya: bar chad bdud dpung 'joms pa'i he ru ka: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal mchog gi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gu hya: hūm̐ hrīḥ mkhyen brtse ye shes gter 'chang gur gum mdangs: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs mgon po kun tu gzigs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: shes rab gter 'chang 'jam dpal dbang thob shog: oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gu hya: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: zhi mdzad bde ba'i gar du bsgyur: rang byung ye shes ster ba'i ma: ḍā ki bde chen dkar mo yi: dbang mchog dam pa bskur ba yis: bde chen bde ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni kā ya wākka tsitta sarba si ddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gu hya: padma dbang gi sku thogs la: hūm̐ hrīḥ sor rtogs ye shes chags bral rang gdangs las: padma 215)drag po rta mgrin he ru ka: rigs bzhi hya grī wa yum dang 'khril: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang chen drag po'i lha tshogs dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥpadma kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra ratna padma karma hya grī wa ḍā ki ni kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ rgya : mkha' 'gro bde chen kun gsal mas bdag la dngos su gsungs ba'o: yang bskal pa lug lor skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs bral chos kyi dbang pos rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye skabs rigs ldan pa khyod da dung bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzod la ma 'ongs pa na bdag gi 'dul bya'i lhag ma skyong dgos sogs gsungs nas khyod thugs sun ma byed dang 'gro don rim bzhin du 'byung ngo zhes gsungs:

rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dbang dang phag mo'i dbang sogs kyang bskur dbugs dbyungs rgyas gdab bas 'di yid la zungs gsungs: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: skye 'gag bral ba 'od gsal chos sku'i mkha': shes rig ma bcos dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras: rdo rje bdun ldan padma 'byung gnas sku: skal ldan khyod la bdag gis bskur ba yis: rgyal kun mkhyen 216) brtse'i ye shes dbang thob nas: 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog gi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa'i mkha' klong nas: rig stong brjod 'das rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad: skal ldan khyod la bdag gis dbang bskur bas: grub brnyes rig 'dzin mchog gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags gsum dril mthar: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dang gzhan yang dbang bskur sna tshogs pa mdzad nas mi snang bar gyur: yang mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhig gis 'di skad gsungasaḥ e ma skal ldan snying gi bu: rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma: chos nyid ngang las so sor gsal: 'gag med ye shes rtogs pa'i yum: rdo rje phag mo'i gsang gsum dbang: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang thob shog: oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni badzra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa hūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ gu hya: zhes gsungs sku'i gar stabs bsgyur nas mi snang bar gyur to: ces pa'ang su kha badzra gyis nyams snang la brten nas bris pa'o// dge'o//
